data.define: Said to show something is perfect, like a great meal.

misuse.text: Don't say 'chef's kiss' about burnt toast.

data.l1_hook: Nếm thử đi rồi nói tui nghe!
data.l1_ex: Món súp này chef's kiss luôn.

native.tip: “chef's kiss” = Hoàn hảo, ngon tuyệt. Ví dụ: “The soup was chef's kiss.”
native.caption:
“chef's kiss” nghĩa là gì?
“chef's kiss” = Hoàn hảo, ngon tuyệt.
Ví dụ: “The soup was chef's kiss.” (Món súp này chef's kiss luôn.)
